title: Baker (2003) London clay slope, Mohr-Coulomb fit

meta.title: Baker (2003) London clay slope, Mohr-Coulomb fit
meta.notes: 43° slope, 6 m high, with the Mohr-Coulomb envelope fitted to London clay data (c′ = 6 kPa, φ′ = 32°); critical-circle search.

source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V008b (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: Search limited to x = 0–13.7 (toe to the crest), as in the source; the level ground left of the toe is not searched.

Baker (2003) also gives 1.48 for this slope with the non-linear envelope through a local linear approximation in Taylor's chart (p. 393, Fig. 7). The search limits x = 0–13.7 are the program manual's; Baker draws the crest to x ≈ 16 and gives none.
